description: Dylect® Eco Solar Security Light Outdoor for 12Hr Runtime, 5 x Movable Panel, Ultra Bright with Advanced Motion Sensor, IP64 Waterproof, Solar Light for Home, Garden, Shop, Parking (Warm + Cool White) - Distributed/Packaged by Dylect. Product Details: High-Brightness Dual LED Lighting Equipped with warm white + cool white LEDs —to deliver 560 lumens of powerful illumination with a 160° beam, ideal for solar light outdoor use in wide spaces. Efficient Solar Charging 5.5V/1.65W polycrystalline panel charges the 2400mAh battery in 8–10 hrs. Provides 10 - 12 hrs of reliable light for driveways, walls, and pathways. Motion Sensor & 3 Smart Modes Features PIR motion + light sensor with remote access to 3 modes: always bright, motion-triggered, or dim + motion boost—adaptable to all use cases. Built for All-Weather Durability Durable ABS + PC housing, rated IP64 waterproof, resists rain, dust, and heat. Functions in harsh environments from -25°C to 64°C. Multi-Panel Setup + Warranty Support Flexible panels for broader lighting. Quick wall-mountable design (340 x 185 x 85 mm, 528g). Includes 12-month warranty.
